name: Paiya Mortgage & Loan Calculator
author: paiyasaravanan

sections.description:
Paiya Mortgage & Loan Calculator is a modern, responsive, and glassmorphic mortgage and loan calculator designed for real estate agents, brokers, financial bloggers, and website owners.

Featuring interactive range sliders, real-time input synchronization, and an animated doughnut chart, it makes it extremely easy for website visitors to calculate their home loan interest and principal payment split.

Looking for advanced features? We also offer a Pro version of this plugin hosted on our website. The Pro version includes advanced PITI (tax, insurance, HOA) breakdowns, dynamic PMI calculation, early payoff simulators, and client-ready A4 PDF report downloads.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the paiya-mortgage-loan-calculator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the zip file directly via the WordPress admin panel under Plugins > Add New > Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Paiya Calculator to configure defaults.
  4. Copy the shortcode [paiya_calculator] and paste it into any post, page, or widget.
sections.faq:
Does it support different currencies?

Yes! You can configure the default currency ($, £, €, ₹) inside the plugin settings panel.

Does it require a database?

No, it runs entirely on highly optimized client-side JavaScript, which ensures lightning-fast load times and zero database queries.
